eyebrow: Two ways to change a cluster

steps.label: kubectl scale --replicas=5
steps.sub: an imperative command: changes state now, leaves no record of intent

steps.label: A Deployment manifest with replicas: 5
steps.sub: declarative: describes the end state, idempotent, diffable

steps.label: Git holds the declarative version
steps.sub: that's what makes it a trustworthy source of truth

code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-api
spec:
  replicas: 5
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: payments-api
          image: registry/payments-api:1.4.2
caption: Desired state expressed as a description of the end result, not a sequence of commands.

code:
gitops-repo/
  apps/
    payments-api/
      base/
        deployment.yaml
        service.yaml
        kustomization.yaml
      overlays/
        staging/
        production/
caption: Every change to this layout is a commit: immutable, diffable, revertible with git revert.
